name: Parameters.valuation_map_relDifferentGen
summary: f maps the primitive root ζ(P, s) to a primitive root, and the derivative of Φ_{N₁(P, s)} at any primitive root generates the same ideal (the relative different).

steps.claim: f(relDifferentGen(P, s)) = Φ′(f(ζ(P, s))) (f is a ring homomorphism), and f(ζ(P, s)) is a primitive N₁(P, s)-th root of unity (f injective); by `relDifferent_spec` both relDifferentGen(P, s) and Φ′(f(ζ(P, s))) generate the different of E/K, so they have the same w-adic valuation.
steps.lean:
w.valuation _ (P.relDifferentGen s).val := by simp [↓valuation_of_algebraMap, intValuation_def,
  ← span_singleton_eq_bot, ← eval_map_apply, ← derivative_map, relDifferent_spec,
  isPrimitiveRoot_zetaInt.map_of_injective h, isPrimitiveRoot_zetaInt]
